messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-restricted ansatz decomposing the square into congruent subregions with one point each

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Arrange 13 points as follows: one at the center (1/2, 1/2), one at each of the four square corners, one at the midpoint of each of the four sides, and one at the midpoint of each of the four segments connecting the center to a corner (coordinates (1/4,1/4), (3/4,1/4), (1/4,3/4), (3/4,3/4)). This configuration decomposes the unit square into eight congruent right isosceles triangles, each subdivided with points at its three vertices and its hypotenuse midpoint, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/32."}
